headline: Weathered Expanse and Farranac Coast Lead Fresh Base Turnover
war_summary: Strategic base turnovers shifted along the northern and coastal sectors over the past three hours, led by renewed friction in Weathered Expanse, Farranac Coast, and Nevish Line, while earlier hotspots Marban Hollow and Olavi's Wake saw base exchanges abruptly pause. Weathered Expanse remained the war's bloodiest theater, posting three fresh base transitions and nearly twenty-seven hundred combined casualties in the latest two-hour span. On the western seaboard, Farranac Coast recorded the capture of Transient Valley amidst heavy fighting that claimed over sixteen hundred lives across two hours, while Nevish Line logged two base events around Tomb Father. Although tactical handovers stalled in Kuura Strand during the latest window, casualty rates accelerated violently to nearly two thousand combined fallen in two hours. Attritional skirmishes likewise surged in Callahan's Passage, Dead Lands, and Stlican Shelf, where heavy casualties mounted steadily along entrenched frontlines without yielding strategic base shifts.
